title: Brown Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together in a large bowl.
Add buttermilk and corn syrup and mix until moistened.
Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake another 30 minutes or until it passes the toothpick test.
Let stand several hours before serving.
story: This quick bread was a family staple at Christmas. After my grandmother died the recipe was lost for 16 years until my aunt came across a copy in her father's handwriting. Most of my family likes this with cream cheese, but butter or just plain is acceptable.
